_about: Paste-ready data for the Sonnet agent who writes gen_checks_v2_shells.py (10_CHECK_FORMS.md). Holds the PERMUTE arrays for general_v2's two forms (disjoint phish slots) and the CHECK_LINES host text for the two Quayholt hosts (Anjali Rao for the AB pair, Darren Price for the BA pair). JSON cannot hold Python tuple keys, so CHECK_LINES is given host-by-host, stage-by-stage; the generator's gen_e6_e7 check() keys CHECK_LINES by a (host_id, stage) tuple, and the 'python' block below shows the exact literal to paste. Hosts and sprite keys come from gen_e3_e5_shells.py HOSTS (anjali -> female_scientist, darren -> male_telecom).

PERMUTE._about: new[i] = old[order[i]]. Forms authored with phish at ordinal slots 2, 4, 6, 8 (0-based indices 1, 3, 5, 7). These two arrays put the phish in DISJOINT output slots: form A phish at 1-based slots {1, 4, 6, 9}, form B phish at 1-based slots {2, 3, 7, 10} (scattered, not alternating, to match the built forms; CHECKFORMS_V2_DESIGN_C1 P1-M1, 2026-10-29). No ordinal slot is a phish in both forms (CHECK_PARITY_AUDIT B1). Verified by hand and by the parity-audit disjointness check; see general_v2_generator_notes verification output in the content agent's report. A pure reorder changes no counts and no flag multiset, so parity holds.

HOSTS._about: Copy these two HOSTS entries across to gen_checks_v2_shells.py (they already exist in gen_e3_e5_shells.py HOSTS). Placeholder sprite keys until PixelLab.

anjali.about: Quayholt's information security analyst, 30s, Indian, moved from Bengaluru; she receives the reports (BRAND_SET.md). Runs the before-and-after checks. Placeholder sprite until PixelLab.

darren.about: Quayholt's service desk team lead and owner of the verification script, 40s, white, from Bristol (BRAND_SET.md). Steady, a bit dry. Placeholder sprite until PixelLab.

CHECK_LINES._about: Each entry is [opening, saved, player-thanks, host-reply], the four strings ink_source() reads (before, after, choice, reply). The dialogue reviewer polishes these. anjali_rao is re-keyed to the tuple form from gen_e3_e5_shells.py (its wording is the same before-and-after check script). darren_price is new.
